name: CC Switch
tagline: An all-in-one agent desktop that lets you manage Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents from a single window.
sentence: A desktop app that combines AI coding agents, terminals and file management in one interface.
what_happened: **One moderate CVE with unverified fix found Oct 16 2026.** CVE-2026-6143 (moderate, GHSA-rrm6-2q2p-cpx5). The fix status is unverified - it may have been patched but the NVD record has not confirmed it.
**Previously featured in Edition 004 (Aug 21 2026).** Pulled from the site and settled as FAIL pending Mac re-check, because the CVE fix could not be verified from the cloud.
why_fail: **One moderate CVE with unverified fix.** CVE-2026-6143 was published April 13 2026. The latest release is 4.0.13 but the NVD has not confirmed the fix.
**Cannot verify from the cloud.** The gate requires Mac re-check to confirm whether the fix is included in the current release.
if_used: Check CVE-2026-6143 on the NVD to understand whether it affects your use case.
Update to the latest version (4.0.13) if you are not already on it - the fix may be included.
Watch for the Mac re-check result. If the fix is confirmed, the gate will clear the repo.
